essence: The Jyeṣṭhā mantra is formed by saying hrīṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ and has seventeen syllables.
Jyeṣṭha-Lakṣmī is the deity, and the mantra includes śrīmāye and the śakti seed syllables.
The six mantra limbs are constructed sequentially using letter groups of three, four, four, one, three, and two.
The practitioner should place the fivefold set on the heart, navel, base, knees, and feet.
The goddess is to be visualized with a body smeared in saffron powder and eyes like blooming lotuses.
